title: API Gateway event.body is a JSON string
message: In API Gateway proxy events, event.body is a JSON string. Parse it with JSON.parse(event.body).

title: queryStringParameters may be null
message: queryStringParameters is null when no query string is sent. Use (event.queryStringParameters ?? {}).

title: HTTP API v2 uses requestContext.http.method
message: HTTP API v2 events use event.requestContext.http.method instead of event.httpMethod.

title: SQS record.body is a JSON string
message: SQS record.body is a string; parse it with JSON.parse(record.body).

title: S3 notification keys are URL-encoded
message: S3 event object keys are URL-encoded (spaces become '+'). Decode with decodeURIComponent(key.replace(/\+/g, ' ')).

title: Base64-encoded request body
message: This event sets isBase64Encoded: true. Decode event.body with Buffer.from(event.body, 'base64').toString('utf8').

title: Headers may be lowercased
message: HTTP API v2 and ALB normalize header names to lowercase. Read headers case-insensitively.

title: Mock response may be missing expected fields
message: The mock for {{service}} lacks a field accessed by your handler. Run Auto-fill mocks to generate missing fields.

title: Environment variable is undefined
message: Set {{envKey}} in Node environment settings (process.env.{{envKey}} was undefined).

title: Function timeout exceeded
message: Task timed out after {{timeoutSec}} s{{slowServiceNote}}. Increase timeout or reduce downstream latency.

title: Unhandled Promise rejection
message: Async call rejected without a catch handler. Wrap awaits in try/catch or return an error response.

title: Module not available in sandbox
message: {{errorMessage}} Use an allow-listed package (uuid, lodash, dayjs, zod, ajv) or a supported cloud SDK shim.
